spec_case: issue #778 step 7, H1 (http_proxy is used for a curl-based adapter's base_url, as an absolute-form request line)
description: Ollama's own base_url names a `.invalid` host a direct connection could never reach; `http_proxy` points at the mock server, which records the request's own absolute-form target (`http://example.invalid/api/generate`) exactly the way the http tool's own proxy case does -- curl's own argv never carries any of this (issue #778 step 7's own --config wiring).
